children: Companhia Paranaense de Energia reported Q3 2026 recurring EBITDA of R$ 1.8B, up 35.0% from R$ 1.3B a year earlier, and recurring net income of R$ 673M, up 79.6% from R$ 375M.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Recurring EBITDA R$ 1.8B, up 35.0% YoY
Strong year-over-year operating growth; the release attributes the quarter's performance mainly to distribution.
Recurring net income R$ 673M, up 79.6% YoY
Profit growth exceeded EBITDA growth, though the release does not quantify the factors bridging the difference.
Distribution recurring EBITDA rose 70.2% to R$ 1.1B
The main segment driver benefited from a tariff reset and 5.8% growth in distributed energy volume.
Q3 consolidated Capex was R$ 991M
Investment supports grid modernization and generation and transmission expansion; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Net debt-to-EBITDA was 2.7x
Leverage was below the company's stated long-term target midpoint of 2.9x, supporting capacity for its expansion plan.
Dona Francisca stake sale generated R$ 151M
The completed divestment added cash and simplified the corporate structure; no sale gain was stated.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a quarterly results update showing growth alongside a tariff reset, higher distribution volumes, and ongoing investment. Further quarters will show whether distribution growth and earnings gains persist as tariff effects and energy volumes evolve.
